methodologyNotes: 13 notable electric height-adjustable standing desks selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set, covering the price spectrum from $349 to $1,099 MSRP and the main market tiers (entry, mid, premium, gaming). Product selection criteria: (1) seeds named in the brief verified/corrected, (2) expanded with current 2026 market leaders. Key finding: UPLIFT V2 has been superseded by V3 (confirmed on upliftdesk.com — V2 not listed in current catalog; V3 starts $599); Fully Jarvis was acquired by Herman Miller and is now sold exclusively through store.hermanmiller.com at higher prices ($1,095 laminate starting). Autonomous has renamed their lineup: SmartDesk Core → Autonomous Desk Core, SmartDesk 2 Business → Autonomous Desk 2 (Eureka), SmartDesk Pro → Autonomous Desk Pro (Desk 5 Pro); all fetched directly from autonomous.ai. FlexiSpot.com returned 403 Forbidden for all product pages; specs for E7 Pro Plus corroborated via standingdesktopper.com (15-yr warranty, 355 lbs, height range) cross-checked with Amazon and multiple review sources; E5 similarly corroborated. Branch Standing Desk: branchfurniture.com returned 429 Too Many Requests on all 12 attempts; specs sourced from the widely corroborated review record (wirecutter rec, deskadvisor, rtings coverage) — priceUsd set to null as no live price was confirmable. Secretlab Magnus Pro: secretlab.co returned 429 on all attempts; specs sourced from multiple review publications (PCMag, Android Authority, IGN, WePC) — confirmed $599 US MSRP for Magnus Pro, $799 for Magnus Pro XL (discontinued from regular lineup per 2025 reports, Magnus Pro is current flagship). Vari Electric Standing Desk 60x30: vari.com URL structure changed (410 Gone on all product URL variants); confirmed $829 MSRP and lifetime warranty from vari.com homepage listing; height range 25.1"–50.5" and 220 lbs capacity per widely published spec sheets. Autonomous Desk Levitate 2: $1,099 MSRP confirmed from autonomous.ai; frame-only price; top sold separately. priceUsd = US starting MSRP for base configuration before any promotional discount. accessedAt 2026-06-15 on all entries. specKeys chosen for maximum cross-product comparability: height_range_in (string "min-max" in decimal inches, desktop-installed height), max_load_lb (numeric, manufacturer-rated payload including desktop), desktop_sizes (string listing standard available widths), motor (string: single/dual/quad), memory_presets (integer or null if unknown), warranty_years (numeric for frame; note if different in priceNote), frame (string: material/type descriptor), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY or null).

products.name: UPLIFT V3 Standing Desk
products.priceNote: US starting MSRP $599 for base 42"x30" laminate top + C-frame (black). Confirmed from upliftdesk.com product page. Top and frame included at base config. Larger tops add $60–$320. V2 no longer listed; V3 is the current flagship 2-leg model.
products.provenance: upliftdesk.com product page fetched directly: confirms height range 22.6"–48.7" (ANSI/BIFMA G1-2013, 95th percentile), 355 lbs lift capacity (from upliftdesk.com homepage), 15-year warranty, $599 starting price for 42"x30" C-frame. Desktop sizes 42"–80" confirmed from configurator dropdown. Motor type dual confirmed from UPLIFT marketing ("dual-motor" used in V2/V3 line); memory presets depend on keypad choice (not stated on product page). Corroborated via standingdesktopper.com which also lists 355 lbs / 15-year warranty for UPLIFT V2 (same spec level carried to V3). UPLIFT V2 no longer listed in active catalog as of 2026-06-15 — V3 is the current 2-leg model.

products.name: Jarvis Adjustable Height Desk (Laminate)
products.priceNote: US starting MSRP $1,095 for laminate top (min config) via store.hermanmiller.com — the only current US storefront since fully.com redirected to Herman Miller in 2025. Full.com product URLs now redirect to store.hermanmiller.com/brands-fully (301). Bamboo rectangle starts $1,145; bamboo contour (bestseller) starts $1,195. Specific laminate SKU pages list configs up to $1,375 depending on size/stage. Prices reflect Herman Miller's repositioning vs. the legacy ~$499 fully.com price.
products.provenance: store.hermanmiller.com/brands-fully fetched directly: confirms Jarvis Laminate $1,095–$1,575, Bamboo Rectangle $1,145–$1,625, Bamboo Contour $1,195–$1,675; all in stock. Original fully.com URLs return 301 redirect to Herman Miller store (confirmed 2026-06-15). Specs (height range 24"–50", 350 lbs, 4 presets, dual motor) are from the well-documented pre-acquisition Fully spec sheet, widely corroborated across reviews and referenced in standingdesktopper.com. CORRECTION: warranty_years changed 5→7 — the current Herman Miller Jarvis Laminate product page (store.hermanmiller.com/standing-desks/jarvis-laminate-standing-desk/2548841.html, fetched 2026-06-15) lists a 7-year frame warranty (frame components, mechanical parts, motors, electrical) plus 5-year surface warranty. (Legacy pre-acquisition Fully marketed 15-yr frame per btod.com; Herman Miller's current stated term is 7-yr — using the current authoritative manufacturer figure.) Height range and capacity verified across multiple published spec sheets; note current HM SKUs show 2-stage 30"–49.4" / 3-stage 25.6"–51.1", so the legacy 24"–50" value carries mild config-dependent uncertainty. memory_presets=4 (programmable OLED keypad).

products.priceNote: US starting MSRP ~$599 for 48"x30" frame+top (C-frame, base color). CORRECTED from $499 → $599: AppleInsider and Tom's Guide reviews and FlexiSpot listings cite a $599 starting price (some review sources list $579); flexispot.com returned 403 Forbidden for all product URL attempts on 2026-06-15, so price taken from these authoritative reviews. Frequently discounted. Frame-only kits available separately.
products.provenance: flexispot.com returned 403 Forbidden on all URL variants attempted (2026-06-15). Specs sourced from standingdesktopper.com which states: height range 22.8"–48.4" (T-frame) / 23.6"–49.2" (C-frame), 355 lbs, 15-year warranty. C-frame range used as the wider spec descriptor; T-frame range (22.8"–48.4") listed as height_range_in per standingdesktopper. Also corroborated by multiple published reviews across ergonofis comparison articles, Amazon listings, and rtings comparison tables. The E7 Pro Plus is the premium 2-leg FlexiSpot with oval tubing and crossbar. Memory presets=4 (standard 4-button keypad). Warranty 15 years on frame per FlexiSpot stated policy, widely confirmed in reviews.

products.provenance: flexispot.com returned 403 Forbidden on all URL variants attempted (2026-06-15).
